concept.title: People wanting to get active
concept.shortdesc: People of any fitness level, including those nervous about exercise, who want gentle or inclusive physical activity.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People who are out of practice, low in fitness or nervous about exercise and want an easy or low impact way back into activity.
: Activities stated as suitable for people of any fitness level, age or ability, including beginners.
